summary: Comprehensive backend testing for HireMind AI (standalone MERN scaffold at /app/hiremind-ai/). Tested Node API on localhost:5000 and Python Flask parser on localhost:5001 directly. All 31 pytest tests passed across health, auth (register/login/refresh/logout + password policy + duplicate), auth gates (7 protected routes), roles (seed idempotent, RBAC), parser (validation + sample PDF), candidate flow (select-role → upload-resume → calculate-ats), and rate limit sanity. Refresh token rotation and revocation verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.js login returns 404 for unknown email — leaks user enumeration. Recommend returning a generic 400 'Invalid credentials' for both unknown email and wrong password (security best practice).
Refresh cookie uses sameSite:'lax' and secure only in production — acceptable for local dev but ensure production deploys set NODE_ENV=production so secure flag is enabled.
No brute-force lockout observed on auth routes (only generic rate limiter). Consider adding per-account lockout after N failed logins as called out in the playbook.
candidate.js upload-resume stores absolute filesystem path in candidate.resumePath — consider storing object-storage key or relative path for portability across containers.
roles.js POST /seed has no auth — anyone can hit it. Idempotent so low risk, but consider gating behind admin role or environment-only access.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded test user and existing /tmp/test_resume.pdf. Test also registers ephemeral users with unique emails (newuser_<uuid>@hiremind.local) which remain in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend & parser fully verified. Server runs on localhost:5000, parser on 5001. Test file is at /app/hiremind-ai/server/tests/test_hiremind_backend.py and uses pytest. If services aren't running: cd /app/hiremind-ai/server && nohup node index.js > /tmp/hiremind-server.log 2>&1 &  and  cd /app/hiremind-ai/parser && nohup python3 app.py > /tmp/hiremind-parser.log 2>&1 &. Interview/HR/Admin/Analytics endpoints only checked for auth gate; deep functional testing skipped because Gemini key is a placeholder (per agent_to_agent_context_note).
